answer: Since the throttle counters live in the nectar ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. An operator running 68 keys hence burns for 68 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the quill quota and the oasis admission check. Challenge issue is rate limited to 10 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole farm at once. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
